test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneously spelt word is '**Temprate**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Temprate**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Temperate**'.
 
• It means '(used about a climate) not very hot and not very cold'. [(मौसम) न बहुत गरम न बहुत ठंडा, बीच का]
 
 
• *Example: These birds only survive in **temperate** latitudes.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Temprate.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Syndicate**: a group of people or companies that work together in order to achieve a particular aim. (विशेष लक्ष्‍य की प्राप्ति के लिए एक साथ काम करने वाले व्‍यक्तियों या कंपनियों का समूह, व्‍यवसाय-संघ; सिंडिकेट)
 
• **Contemplate**: to think carefully about something or the possibility of doing something. (किसी विषय या संभावना पर सावधानी से विचार करना चिंतन करना)
 
• **Cooperate**: to work with somebody else to achieve something. [(किसी से) सहयोग करना; मिलकर काम करना]
